scenarios.title: Restart after the scroll is taken and read: no second scroll (I4, I6)
scenarios.provenance: Hero created fresh, clvl 17 by stat verbs, purse 5000, waypoints Cold Plains to Dark Wood, board records as the scenario says. CHEATED: waypoints and level are SETUP writes (mechanics evidence only, never balance).
scenarios.notes: labops2 2026-11-28, second change: the chain is accepted in the setup (pre.board scroll, board_also read, as stop-cascades does) instead of a start tap at 20 wall seconds. With the tap the levelling plan had already walked the Paladin into the Forgotten Tower and the chunk parked gave_up in one second (seeds 11 and 3, card boardsidestart TASK-1120); from the setup the chunk starts about 4 s after the bot, in town. labops2 2026-11-28: restart_at_s 150 and budget 60 (was 300 and 30: the 30 virtual minutes ended after about 150 WALL seconds for the Paladin, so the restart came after the budget; the scroll was read at 92 wall seconds). The assertion counts chunk starts, not step lines (a failed tree click logs the step again in the same process, V Paladin 11 log). U: a hero that has not finished the chunk at the restart starts it again and reads RED (Sorceress 3 in the lab night, out of mana): that is a setup fault, not a finding. trigger.restart_at_s: the bot is stopped (SIGTERM, save and quit) and started again on the same hero and plan file; the first leg must have taken the scroll (U: timing, tune restart_at_s).

assert.why: the chunk started once, before the restart, and is not started again after it (I4, I6); the step line itself repeats on a retry inside one process

scenarios.title: A parked chunk (hold_timeout) is still parked after a restart (Q5, I9)
scenarios.provenance: Hero created fresh, clvl 17 by stat verbs, purse 5000, waypoints Cold Plains to Dark Wood, board records as the scenario says. CHEATED: waypoints and level are SETUP writes (mechanics evidence only, never balance).
scenarios.notes: labops2 2026-11-28 (lab runs 20261128-010108 Paladin 11, 20261128-011304 Sorceress 3, restart_at_s 420 WALL seconds): the park of this setup is NOT hold_timeout. Sorceress 3: the recovery ends, the chunk starts and the tower guard refuses three times (`0 mana potions < 2 (caster)`), `quest board: parked forgotten_tower/countess` at 62 virtual minutes, gave_up; after the restart the bot logs `forgotten_tower/countess parked: The Forgotten Tower is stuck` and does not start the chunk again (V log). Paladin 11: the hero recovers, walks to the Countess and the run is auto-finished, no park, so the Paladin is out of the matrix until a setup parks it (U). The assertions follow that: parked once, blocked at the end (any park reason), started at most once. restart_at_s is wall time and the park came 320 s after the bot start at pace 9: on a host twice as slow the restart comes before the park and the row reads RED for a harness reason (U).

assert.why: the chunk parked once, before the restart
after the restart the park is kept: the chunk is not started again (the restart drill, TASK-983)
